title: Applied Researcher
description:
About US
Pixocial (https://www.pixocial.com/) is at the forefront of the GenAI paradigm shift, delivering cutting-edge AI-powered creative solutions to individuals and enterprises worldwide. We completed our fundraising through top-tier global investors in 2023, with a mission to democratize AI technology, making sophisticated digital art accessible to all. Our diverse team consists of over 200 professionals across 9 countries, headquartered in both the US and Singapore.

- 200+ Team Members
- 42M+ Monthly Active Users
- 2M Valid Paying Customers
- 150M+ Generated Outputs

We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and do not engage in discrimination based on race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, or any other status protected by law.

About AI Lab

Our team, Pixocial AI Lab, plays a crucial role in advancing the AI capabilities of our products. Our team is committed to supporting products with state-of-the-art algorithms, conducting world-class research to drive next-gen products, and cultivating top-tier AI researchers and engineers for the company.

Our research topics spans image and video editing and generation, 3D editing, generation, and reconstruction, multi-modal generation, and other relevant topics in computer vision and generative AI. We advance the frontier through seminal research and work closely with internal partners to deliver impactful products.

Role Overview:
We are seeking Applied Researchers with relevant experience in image and video generation to join our AI Lab.
Ideal candidates are highly self-motivated to advance the state-of-the-art in computer vision and generative AI.
Through collaboration, we aim to make significant product impacts and conduct seminal research.

This is an on-site role based in Bellevue, WA. We offer relocation assistance to new employees.

Key Responsibilities:
- Research and develop state-of-the-art image and video generation models within specific domains
- Collaborate internally and externally to conduct seminal research to advance the frontier
- Serve as a mentor to teammates when necessary to collectively cultivate a strong technical team

Basic Qualifications:
• Industrial research experience, either as a full-time employee or intern, with relevant projects in computer vision, computer graphics, or NLP.
• For US Based Candidates: Must obtain work authorization in the country of employment at the time of hire, and maintain ongoing work authorization during employment.

Preferred Qualifications:
• PhD in computer vision, computer graphics, NLP, or related areas.
• Interested in and thoughtful about product impacts of AI technology
• Solid engineering skills to implement ideas programmatically, from research prototypes to product deliverables.
• Strong problem solving skills to compare alternative potential solutions and access technical tradeoffs, thereby determining a path forward.
• Strong communication skills, to effectively understand complex ideas and convey them clearly to diverse audiences.
• Strong research record with first-authored publications at top-tier conferences such as CVPR, ECCV, ICCV, NeurIPS, and SIGGRAPH.
• 2+ years of work experience in a relevant industry or university.

title: 订阅策略产品经理
description:
我们正在寻求一位经验丰富的订阅产品经理加入我们的团队，领导我们消费产品的订阅战略，包括我们的旗舰产品 AirBrush 应用程序。理想的候选人应具有深厚的产品管理背景，在提高订阅指标方面有良好的业绩记录，并在执行和优化订阅增长战略方面拥有丰富的实践经验

主要职责
- 制定并实施全面的订阅增长战略，推动收入增长。
- 分析市场趋势、竞争格局和用户数据，发掘加快订阅增长的机会。
- 优化和创新订阅模式、定价和包装，最大限度地提高订阅用户的转化率、保留率和终身价值。
- 与产品、设计和工程团队合作，实施和迭代订阅功能。
- 持续监控和分析订阅性能指标，提出可行的见解，推动关键绩效指标的持续改进。
- 开展用户研究并收集客户反馈，为订阅策略和产品改进提供依据。
- 了解行业趋势和最新实践，保持竞争优势。

任职资格
- 计算机科学、商务、市场营销或相关专业的学士学位。
- 5 年以上产品管理经验，主要侧重于开发和扩展订阅产品。
- 在通过创新和有效战略大幅增加订阅收入和订阅用户数量方面拥有良好的业绩记录。
- 具有很强的分析能力和数据驱动决策的经验。
- 在 A/B 测试、用户研究和订阅优化方面拥有深厚的专业知识。
- 出色的沟通和协作技能。
- 能够在快节奏的动态环境中工作，同时管理多个项目。

加分项
- 具有消费者应用程序经验，尤其是在照片编辑、人工智能或相关数字内容创建领域。
- 深入了解移动应用程序订阅的最佳实践和新兴趋势。
- 熟悉数字营销和用户获取策略。
- 热衷于创新，走在行业趋势的前沿。
- 英语可作为工作语言者优先
